nome_jp: 破壊王エメラルド・バベル
testo:
■ When you put this creature or another Hunter into the battle zone, you may destroy one of your opponent's creatures. If you do, choose a non-evolution creature in your opponent's graveyard. Your opponent puts that creature into the battle zone.
